text:
Sophie - Partner Eng: FYI — ACME partner just announced a new driver bundle (driver-515.87 + CUDA 12.2.1) that some SI images will pick up automatically. Need a short plan for pinning, canaries, and a hotfix path.
Alex M: Thanks — can we avoid a silent rollout into marketplace images. We should pin exact driver + cuda tag on our official AMIs and docker base images.
Tara (PM): +1. Business wants zero surprise for customers using Dedicated and Marketplace. We should coordinate announcement messaging with ACME and our Marketplace PM.
Mike Infra: Proposed ops checklist:
- pin kernel module and driver package in AMI bake job
- add a canary lane in us-west-2 and eu-west-1
- smoke tests for quant ops and perf regression
- rollback image tag and driver-uninstall script ready
I'll drop the bake job diff later.
Sophie - Partner Eng: Quick compatibility notes I got from ACME: they say CUDA 12.2.1 is ABI-compatible with 12.2 but there are a couple of new kernels we need to watch (quant kernels + cuBLAS paths). They flagged a possible perf regression in LLM concat op.
Emily Support: Can we surface a short advisory for customers who pin older stacks? Also include how to opt into early canary.
Alex M: For pinning, use explicit tags in dockerfiles, e.g.:
```
FROM redwood/runtime:ubuntu22-cuda12.2.0-driver-514.86
# When we rotate: ubuntu22-cuda12.2.1-driver-515.87
```
And AMI metadata: `driver_pin: 515.87, cuda_tag: 12.2.1`
Sophie - Partner Eng: I'll coordinate a joint comms draft with ACME marketing. We should also request their internal regression matrix for our common ops (embedding, generation, kv cache).
Mike Infra: Canary plan details:
- Day 0: bake images with pinned driver, push to private marketplace repo `redwood-marketplace/cuda-canary`
- Day 1-2: route 1% dedicated traffic in us-west-2 to canary nodes
- Run perf/accuracy evals via our Optimize harness every 2 hours
- If <3% perf delta and no accuracy regressions, expand to 10%
If regression observed: immediate rollback to previous AMI tag and open `#regression-hotfix` thread.
Tara (PM): Who owns the rollback playbook? Need SLO for time-to-rollback. Suggest 2 hours from detection to rollback on Dedicated customers.
Mike Infra: Infra oncall owns execution; commit to 2 hours SLA for rollback during business hours. We'll document steps: bake rollback AMI, update autoscale group, invalidate cache.
Emily Support: I'll prepare templated customer notes and an opt-in link for early canary. Also add KB entries showing how to pin in self-hosted setups.
Sophie - Partner Eng: Action items:
- Sophie: coordinate comms + ask ACME for regression matrix (ETA EOD)
- Mike: PR for bake job pin + canary repo setup (ETA tomorrow morning)
- Alex: update dockerfile examples and ops snippet (ETA EOD)
